name: Alexei Volkov
notes: Subject is a former GRU officer, now operating as a 'security consultant' through his firm, Argus Security, based in Cyprus. Observed meeting with Klaus Richter in Geneva on 2023-10-05. Believed to facilitate sensitive technology transfers.

name: Klaus Richter
notes: CEO of Richter Dynamics, a Berlin-based firm specializing in 'clean energy solutions'. Financial analysis suggests significant R&D in restricted aerospace technologies. Subsidiary, 'RD Innovations', has funded OmniGen labs.

name: Sofia Rossi
notes: Rome-based art dealer. Her gallery is suspected to be a front for laundering funds for various international clients. Has financial ties to Finanz Stability AG, a Swiss bank. Phone records show contact with Alexei Volkov.

name: Dr. Aris Thorne
notes: Prominent biochemist, previously with the UK's Porton Down, now director at OmniGen, a private research lab in London. OmniGen's work on gene-editing is highly advanced. Subject is under surveillance.

name: Elena Petrova
notes: Lead cybersecurity analyst for a Kyiv-based tech firm. Previously associated with the hacktivist group 'Black September'. Was a contractor for a network security audit at Richter Dynamics.

name: Marcus Vance
notes: Logistics coordinator for Sea Serpent Logistics, a global shipping company based in Baltimore. The company has been flagged for anomalous shipping routes in the South China Sea. Brother of Dr. Aris Thorne.

name: Chen Lin
notes: Materials scientist at Aethelred Industries in Shanghai. Aethelred has a public-facing partnership with Richter Dynamics on advanced polymer development. Subject is a person of interest.

name: Isabella Cruz
notes: Investigative journalist based in Washington D.C. Published an expose on Sea Serpent Logistics. Travel records indicate a recent trip to London, where she met an undisclosed source.

name: Victor Orlov
notes: An associate of Alexei Volkov and the on-site manager for Argus Security in Limassol, Cyprus. Handles operational logistics and recruitment.

name: Dr. Evelyn Reed
notes: Senior geneticist at OmniGen, recruited from a US-based biotech firm. She is a close colleague of Dr. Aris Thorne and specializes in CRISPR technology.

name: Jamal Al-Fayed
notes: Dubai-based financier. Believed to be a key financial intermediary for multiple state-sponsored groups. Uses a complex network of shell companies, including a holding company that owns Finanz Stability AG.

name: Freja Eriksen
notes: Lead engineer at Richter Dynamics' advanced propulsion division. Formerly with the European Space Agency. Her work is highly classified.

name: Liam O'Connell
notes: Former IRA operative, now a 'fixer' based in Dublin. Known contact of Marcus Vance. Believed to arrange discreet transportation for sensitive cargo.

name: Yuki Tanaka
notes: Robotics expert at a Tokyo university. Has received multiple grants from a foundation secretly controlled by Klaus Richter. Her research has potential military applications.

name: Nadia Petrova
notes: Sister of Elena Petrova. A student at the University of Warsaw. No known illicit activities, but maintains regular contact with her sister.

name: Simon Wexler
notes: Lobbyist in Washington D.C. Represents several foreign technology firms, including a subsidiary of Aethelred Industries. Has been flagged for FARA violations.

name: Anya Sharma
notes: AI researcher in Bangalore. Her startup, 'Cognition AI', was recently acquired by a shell company traced back to Richter Dynamics. She now works on autonomous drone guidance systems.

name: David Chen
notes: Cybersecurity analyst with the FBI, based in San Francisco. He is the lead investigator on the 'Black September' case and has expressed interest in Elena Petrova.

name: Maria Flores
notes: Cartel lawyer based in Mexico City. Has been observed meeting with representatives from Sea Serpent Logistics, suggesting a potential partnership in narcotics trafficking.

name: Leo Martin
notes: Interpol agent based in Lyon, France. He is coordinating the international investigation into Alexei Volkov's network and has requested intel on Sofia Rossi.

name: Samir Khan
notes: Karachi-based arms dealer. Has been linked to the sale of restricted European-made drone components. Financial records show payments originating from an account linked to Victor Orlov.

name: Eva Rostova
notes: Former colleague of Alexei Volkov at the GRU. Now a cultural attaché in Vienna, Austria. Maintains discreet contact with Volkov.

name: Ben Carter
notes: Undercover agent for the CIA. Currently embedded within Sea Serpent Logistics' European operations in Rotterdam. He is the source for journalist Isabella Cruz.

name: Dr. Ivan Petrov
notes: Head of a research institute in Moscow. Publicly denounces OmniGen's work, but intelligence suggests a covert channel of communication with Dr. Aris Thorne.

name: Laura Brandt
notes: Chief Financial Officer at Richter Dynamics. She is responsible for the complex financial structures that obscure the company's military R&D funding. Works closely with Klaus Richter in Berlin.
